item.title: CERC Refuses To Grant Relief From Trading Licence Revocation
item.description: The Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) has dismissed a review petition filed by Kreate Energy (India) Pvt. Ltd., reaffirming its earlier decision to pursue revocation of the company’s inter-State trading license over prolonged payment defaults. item.title: TN: Powergrid Floats 375 MW/1,500 MWh BESS Tender for 1.5 Charge-Discharge Cycles
item.description: POWERGRID has issued a tender for setting up seven projects of 375 MW/1,500 MWh standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) with complete 1.5-cycle charging and discharging in Tamil Nadu under the Build, Own and Operate (BOO) model. item.description: Gujarat-based KPI Green Energy has achieved a significant early milestone in its ongoing 250 MW AC / 350 MW DC grid-connected solar IPP project awarded by Gujarat Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (GUVNL). item.title: Will A Hit On The Winter Olympics Convince Climate Skeptics?
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympic Games will begin on February 6, followed by the Winter Paralympics on March 6, with events spread across northern Italy. While Milan will host most indoor competitions, outdoor events will take place in the Alpine resort town of Cortina d’Ampezzo. item.title: Q3 Results: Adani Green’s Net Profit Slumps on One-Off Charges
item.description: Indian renewable energy developer Adani Green Energy on Friday announced its financial results for the third quarter (Q3) and the nine months ended FY2025–26, reporting a sharp decline in net profit due to exceptional items. According to disclosures made to the stock exchanges, the company reported a net profit of just ₹5 crore for Q3 FY26, a steep fall from ₹644 crore recorded in the preceding quarter (Q2 FY26).
